findings.summary: Requirements R1, R2, and R3 are incorrectly traced to Milestone M2 in the sample checks. The plan artifacts demonstrate that these requirements are fully delivered and verified in Milestone M1.

evidence.note: Milestone M1 Deliverable DL2 explicitly covers recursive file discovery (R1).
evidence.quote: Recursive .md file discovery from input directory (R1)

evidence.note: Milestone M1 Exit Criteria confirms passing AT1, which verifies R1.
evidence.quote: AT1 passes: three nested .md files discovered, non-.md excluded

evidence.note: Milestone M2 deliverables are scoped to tag extraction (R11-R13) and do not include R1-R3.

findings.summary: Sample check for R3 (AT3) and Milestone 1 exit criteria require a configuration-based exclusion mechanism, but the plan schedules file/directory exclusion capability (R20 / DL26) in Milestone 5. This creates a trace inconsistency: AT3 cannot be executed as written at M1 without implementing an exclusion feature earlier or revising the test/procedure.

evidence.note: Sample check ties R3 to AT3 and milestones M1/M2
AT3 procedure explicitly uses a configuration that excludes a Markdown file
M1 exit criteria requires AT3 to pass
R20 defines exclusion as SHOULD (not planned until Milestone 5)
Milestone 5 deliverable DL26 implements file/directory exclusion

findings.summary: Deterministic sample checks map R1–R3 to milestones [M1, M2], but the plan’s milestone structure indicates R1–R3 are delivered in M1; M2 is focused on tags (R11–R13). The extra milestone association may dilute trace precision.

evidence.note: R1 sample check lists milestones M1 and M2
R2 sample check lists milestones M1 and M2
R3 sample check lists milestones M1 and M2
M2 scope is tag extraction/pages/navigation rather than ingestion/rendering baseline

findings.summary: R1 is covered by AT1 and milestones M1/M2, but M2 does not deliver any R1 functionality—M2 focuses on tags (R11-R13). R1 is fully delivered in M1 only.
